draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 6.72, the 5th-best grade among 261 2022 draftees and 2nd of 28 at DE. He went 5th overall, close to where his grade ranked. Published comparison: Brian Orakpo. Testing standouts: 40-yard dash (85th percentile), 10-yard split (86th percentile). College production: 7 sacks in 2021, 10th of 28 DEs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 5 pro, currently with the New York Giants. 53 career games and 53 starts over 4 completed seasons, plus 4 so far in 2026. Trending down from his peak: 4 AV in 2025 against a career-best 9 in 2023. Weak spots: missed tackle rate 19.4% (3rd percentile). Played 10 of 17 games in 2025. Versus the typical Year-4 edge rusher who played: 2.5 sacks against a median of 3.0, below the norm.
